name: glider-reward-bench-suite-reasoning
description: A suite designed to evaluate reward models and ranking/selection behavior on reasoning-focused problems. It measures how well reward models or systems prefer higher-quality/ more correct reasoning outputs across tasks such as logical, mathematical, and commonsense reasoning, typically via pairwise comparisons or ranked choices.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset used mainly by researchers developing and evaluating reward models and ranking for reasoning; limited mainstream adoption.
